response.sql: WITH linked AS (SELECT o.orderbase AS orderbase, f.feerate AS feerate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL), ch AS (SELECT orderbase, AVG(feerate) AS avg_rate FROM linked WHERE orderbase IS NOT NULL GROUP BY orderbase), b AS (SELECT AVG(feerate) AS bm FROM linked) SELECT AVG(ch.avg_rate) AS mean_avg_fee_rate, AVG(ch.avg_rate - b.bm) AS mean_excess_over_benchmark FROM ch, b WHERE ch.avg_rate > b.bm
